comparison.objective: Release a cam-clamped camera plate, clear a retaining lip, and transfer it safely; candidate registers and secures two proximity-switch endpoints.
comparison.physical_skill: Cam release, edge-clearance extraction, and supported transfer versus partial screw loosening, constrained sliding, sensing, holding, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Camera must clear the mount and rest upright on a pad without drop or damage; candidate needs two over-center registrations at ≤6 mm retained for 3 seconds.
comparison.reason: The record tests removal from a passive retainer, not feedback-guided mounted-component calibration. Candidate screw geometry, tightening torque, indicator hysteresis, and allowable post-tightening drift are missing.
